stories.title: Deeside liquid carbon capture plant given green light
stories.summary: The carbon capture phase of a new £282 million waste-to-energy plant on Deeside Industrial Estate has been approved. stories.title: Referrals to North Wales Police online child abuse team up 145 per cent
stories.summary: Referrals to North Wales Police’s online child abuse investigation team rose by 145 per cent between 2024 and 2025, the force has said. The team is running a month-long safeguarding drive through August, on the basis that children spend more time online during the school holidays. stories.title: Burning smell across Flintshire this morning is coming from 150 miles away
stories.summary: The smell of smoke across Flintshire this morning is coming from wildfires burning in south Wales, North Wales Fire and Rescue Service has said. The service said its control room had taken a high volume of calls about the smoke and asked people not to tie up emergency lines unless they can see a fire.

stories.title: North Wales Police chief backs national call to stop release of PC Harper’s killers
stories.summary: Chief Constable Amanda Blakeman of North Wales Police has backed a national call for the Government to prevent the early release of two men convicted over the killing of PC Andrew Harper.
